verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents broad API coverage. It publishes OpenAPI specs for many APIs (Ingestion, Query, Raw Data Export, Identity, Service Accounts, Lexicon Schemas, Annotations, GDPR, Feature Flags, Experiments, Data Pipelines, Warehouse Connectors). Its Query API returns the same calculated results seen in web-app reports, and the hosted MCP server can create dashboards. However, nothing documents full UI-to-API parity: report and dashboard authoring is shown only through MCP, and Session Replay sampling is described as managed from the UI. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, documented REST API for creating/editing reports and dashboards, API control of Session Replay settings and other UI-only configuration, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
